blocks.content: Modern JavaScript refers to the features introduced in ES6 and later versions:

items: Better variable declarations - const and let instead of var
Powerful array methods - map(), filter(), forEach(), some(), every()
Destructuring and spread - Extract and combine data elegantly
Safety features - Optional chaining (?.) and nullish coalescing (??)

blocks.content: These aren't optional extras or fancy tricks. This is how professional JavaScript is written in 2026. If you read modern codebases, documentation, or tutorials, you'll see these patterns everywhere.
